confirmed_solution_evidence: A latest incoming customer message explicitly states that the remedy is working or that no further help is needed.
unresolved_evidence: The latest incoming message says the issue continues.
The customer requests urgent assistance or asks that the case remain open.
The detail response belongs to a different conversation ID.
Message records within one detail response contain conflicting conversation IDs.
write_acceptance: The immediate response names the requested conversation ID.
A later GET of that exact ID shows the requested assignee or status.
The queue list agrees with the exact-detail readback.
failure_action: Stop on the affected item, preserve its unresolved status, report the exact mismatch, and do not infer assignment, resolution, delivery, or SLA completion from the immediate response.
